head: RaceCut: song to video app turns your track into a singing race
dek: RaceCut, a new free iPhone app, turns a song into a short vertical video where marbles, balls or a band race, and whoever leads is the one singing. It was #94 in Photo & Video on the US App Store's free chart on 16 November.
details: It has seven games, including Marble Race, Musical Path, Bounce Battles and a concert Stage. Each racer gets an AI voice from Jammable, and the voices hand off when the lead changes. You add a song from your files or the audio of a video from your camera roll, pick 15, 30 or 60 seconds depending on your plan, and the app adds subtitles transcribed on the phone. RaceCut Plus and RaceCut Unlimited are subscriptions that renew until you cancel them.
where: iPhone and iPad, free on the App Store with RaceCut Plus and Unlimited subscriptions (out since 13 November)
means: If you post Shorts, Reels or TikToks, you can turn a song into a ready-made vertical video without editing it yourself.
todo: Try the free version first and check which song length your plan allows before you subscribe. The maker says you're responsible for the audio you upload.
